checks.title: 20 concurrent identical bet requests debit once
checks.assumption: Clients retry with the exact same actionId and body.
checks.method: Fire 20 identical POST /api/rounds in parallel; count successful responses, replays, ledger bet entries and balance.

checks.title: 20 concurrent bets with distinct actionIds and the same revision: exactly one succeeds
checks.assumption: Revision compare-and-swap serialises competing actions.
checks.method: Fire 20 different-ID bets at revision 0 in parallel.

checks.title: 20 concurrent identical advance requests advance one stop
checks.assumption: As S01.
checks.method: Bet with hazards forced safe; fire 20 identical advances.

checks.title: 50 concurrent identical collect-all requests credit each container once
checks.assumption: As S01.
checks.method: Bet $30.01, force safe stop 1, advance, then 50 identical collect-all.

checks.title: Cash-out racing an eliminating advance: exactly one wins, no double outcome
checks.assumption: The next stop is forced (test fixture) to eliminate all onboard cargo.
checks.method: 40 trials per adapter: after stop 1, force stop 2 to hit every container, then send collect-all and advance concurrently with the same revision.

checks.title: Forged financial fields in requests are ignored
checks.assumption: The server must not trust client-supplied outcomes.
checks.method: Add multiplier100, payoutCents, balanceCents, hazards, step, status, serverSeed and a different difficulty to bet/advance/collect bodies; compare credited amounts with the server formula.

checks.title: Invalid wagers, difficulties and client seeds are rejected without persisted change
checks.assumption: Server-side validation is authoritative.
checks.method: Submit 28 malformed bets; compare the stored session JSON before and after each.

checks.title: Protocol validation: action IDs, revisions, body shape, size, content type, origin and routes
checks.assumption: docs/API.md error contract.
checks.method: Send each malformed request and compare the HTTP status with the documented code.

checks.title: No active-round HTTP response contains the server seed or hazards
checks.assumption: publicRound()/snapshot() are the only projections.
checks.method: 30 rounds per adapter; after each action capture session GET, round GET, POST response and an exact replay; search each whole response for the stored seed string and the round proof for serverSeed/hazards keys.

checks.title: Mixed-strategy campaign: ledger, settlement formula, proofs and collision mapping reconcile
checks.assumption: Server outcomes are authoritative; animation follows them.
checks.method: 80 rounds per adapter with a deterministic action policy (random collections of individual containers, collect-all, sail). After every sail compare collisionFor(previous, next) with the server statuses. After settlement verify each credit equals payout(stake, multiplier at collectedAt), run verifyRound(), and check start + Σledger = balance.

checks.title: Client disconnect immediately after sending a bet, then exact retry: one debit (local HTTP)
checks.assumption: Clients retry uncertain requests with the same body and actionId.
checks.method: 10 trials: write the request over a raw socket and destroy it straight away; then retry the identical request via fetch and inspect the ledger.

checks.title: Storage failures before/after commit: no partial effect; exact retry is safe
checks.assumption: Fault injected in fs.writeFileSync (local) or the SQLite stand-in (worker); production code unchanged.
checks.method: Local: throw once from writeFileSync during a bet. Worker: throw once before UPDATE, and once after UPDATE has committed. Then retry the identical request.

checks.title: F10: idempotency-key edge cases cause false conflicts
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F10.
checks.method: Fresh session: POST /api/reset with actionId "constructor" (valid per regex). Then replay a completed collect with the same fields in a different key order.

checks.title: F01/F09: free funding — reset restores $1,000 after a loss; every cookieless GET creates a funded session
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F01 and F09.
checks.method: Lose a $3.01 round (forced), POST /api/reset; then issue 25 cookieless GET /api/session and count stored sessions.

checks.title: F03: session growth reaches the D1 2,000,000-byte row limit and blocks settlement
checks.assumption: Cloudflare D1 documents a 2,000,000-byte maximum string/BLOB/row; emulated in the SQLite stand-in.
checks.method: Natural run: play minimum-stake Easy rounds (bet, sail, collect) through the real Worker until a write is refused; record the round count, stored size and whether money was stranded. Boundary fixture: emulate a session whose bet was the last write that fit, then attempt to settle. Separately measure bytes per round on the local store.
checks.interpretation: The wallet became unusable; whether a wager is stranded depends on which write crosses the limit first.

checks.title: F05: survivors at the final port stay uncredited until an explicit collect
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F05.
checks.method: Force all containers safe, sail to the final stop of each mode, attempt another advance, inspect status and ledger; then collect.

checks.title: F07: two Store instances on one directory lose an update
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F07 (local store is documented as single-process).
checks.method: Open two Store objects on one temp directory; debit 100 cents through the first, then write unrelated data through the stale second; reload from disk.

checks.title: F08: verifyRound() accepts altered unvalidated metadata
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F08.
checks.method: Settle a natural (unforced) engine round, then alter proof.algorithm, multiplier100, id, a container valueCents, nextRisk, maxStops and timestamps, and append a duplicate container; run verifyRound() on each.

checks.title: F11: changing the payout table mid-round changes the settlement of an accepted wager
checks.assumption: Reported in audit F11. MODES is frozen only at the top level.
checks.method: In this process only: accept an Easy round, sail to stop 1, change MODES.easy.payouts[0] from 103 to 104 (models a deployment), collect, restore the table.

checks.title: UTF-8 characters split across request body chunks
checks.assumption: A client seed may contain multi-byte characters; TCP may split a body anywhere.
checks.method: Local: write the bet body in two socket writes 60 ms apart, splitting the 4-byte "🚢" between them; compare the stored clientSeed with the one sent. Worker: same split via a ReadableStream body.

checks.title: "Refill" sets the balance to $1,000 even when the balance is higher
checks.assumption: UI text says "Set your play balance to $1,000.00".
checks.method: Win a forced round so the balance exceeds $1,000, then POST /api/reset; inspect the ledger entry.
